name: Libanius
bio: Libanius, the Antiochene orator and rhetorician of the fourth century AD, is the poet to whom Paton ascribes the epitaph on the emperor Jovian. Paton's Index of Authors includes the poet among those of Book VII. The scan of Paton's index of authors used here does not give a date for the poet; the date shown is the conventional one.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 747).

poems.title: Book VII, 747
poems.author: Libanius
poems.text: Jovian lies here on the further bank of the strong current of Tigris, a good king and a valiant warrior.’
